A 10 gal is pretty small to get much size, but you could start there. Do an internet search for bamboo sellers in your area, since they'll only carry the bamboos that survive in your climate. A lot of those sites have useful info on bamboo in general. (There's bamboo that tolerates -20F in the US north east.) Or you might keep your eye out for bamboo growing in your area and see if the owner will let you dig up a chunk of the rhizome with some culms/canes.

The rhizomes grow laterally, at or 'near' the surface, and both the roots and culms grow out of them. You want the longest/largest piece of rhizome you can fit into your container, and the more undamaged roots the better. You also want at least one culm on that rhizome, but more would be better.
